title: From Amaterasu to the Sun
speaker: Boris Kardoš
paragraphs: The programme will also include observing the real Sun through a specially equipped telescope.

Travel from ancient Japanese legends to modern astronomy. Meet Amaterasu, the Japanese goddess of the Sun, and discover how scientists in Japan study our nearest star using space probes, including the Japanese Hinode spacecraft.
The programme will be presented by Boris Kardoš of the Juraj Bardy Astronomy Club.
